Nova Londinium was a city that seemed to have emerged from a Gothic nightmare. Its cobbled streets, always damp from the persistent fog, snaked between gray stone buildings that defied the passage of time. The architecture, a mixture of Gothic and Victorian styles, created an oppressive and gloomy atmosphere, where shadows lengthened and secrets were hidden in every corner, the streets and buildings full of red roses all year round, The city was divided into two: the Upper City, where the aristocracy and royalty resided, and the Lower City, a labyrinth of alleys and slums inhabited by the working class and the marginalized. A murky river meandered through the center of the city dividing the two worlds and serving as a constant reminder of the inequality that separated them. The royal gardens, once a place of beauty and tranquility, were now a pale reflection of its past, the unkempt paths were a reflection of what once was. 
The castle, an imposing structure that dominated the city, was a symbol of power and authority. However, its walls, once impregnable, were now full of cracks and scars, as if the city itself were sick.
On the outskirts of the city, dark forests and mysterious swamps stretched out, where the creatures of the night moved with stealth. These places were said to be the home of evil spirits and other supernatural forces.
Nova Londinium was a place where hope seemed to have been extinguished. The fog that covered the city was more than a meteorological phenomenon; it was a metaphor for the darkness that had enveloped the kingdom, at the end of the nineteenth century, it was a city in constant evolution, where tradition merged with innovation. The city was marked by a dark and mysterious atmosphere: Shrouded in a perpetual haze and with a Gothic architecture, an emerging technology, the city was at the forefront of the Industrial Revolution, with steam engines, electricity in its early stages and the first automobiles. However, these innovations coexisted with older practices, such as alchemy, supernatural influences, legends and myths about supernatural creatures.
